title: Sunset Session

conditions.headline: AI Swell Rolls Back In
conditions.summary: Stocks bounced back from Tuesday's slide as AI and chip names rallied behind CoreWeave's strong results. The Nasdaq led with a 1.6% gain and Apple hit a record.

sections.title: Closing Bell
items: S&P 500 closed at 7,619.38, up 98.45 points or 1.3%.
Nasdaq Composite rose 1.6% to 25,466.19; the Dow gained 0.5% to 52,486.49; the Russell 2000 added 0.9% to 2,846.26.
AI and chip stocks rebounded after Tuesday's sell-off, led by CoreWeave's beat-and-raise quarter.
Tech led early with energy and industrials; health care, staples and financials lagged. The S&P hit day highs around midday and held gains.
Apple closed at a record high near $355, worth about $5.2 trillion.

sections.title: Macro & Fed
items: Veterans Day: stocks traded normally but the cash bond market was closed. The 10-year last closed near 4.99% on Tuesday.
No major US economic data today. The NRF retail monitor showed October retail sales up 0.2% from September.
Futures price roughly a 90% chance of a Fed rate hike in December after Tuesday's hot CPI; Goldman now sees hikes in December and March.
WTI crude rose to about $87 on fading Iran diplomacy and Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks.
Gold fell about 1% to roughly $3,991; bitcoin rose about 0.9% to near $74,400.

sections.title: Biggest Movers
items: CRWV (CoreWeave): +24% — Q3 revenue up 168% and 2026 revenue outlook raised to $13.0–13.3 billion.
SNDK (SanDisk): +13% — memory and chip stocks rallied.
MU (Micron): +12% — semiconductors recovered from last week's losses.
DELL (Dell): +12% — AI hardware names rebounded.
ORCL (Oracle): +9% — joined the AI infrastructure rally.
NVDA (Nvidia): about +3% — rebound after a two-day slide tied to downgrades and a board investigation.
MSFT (Microsoft): -2.3% and META (Meta): -2.0% — megacaps lagged the chip rally.
LULU (Lululemon): about -4% — slowing revenue and repeated outlook cuts.

sections.title: Earnings Today & Tonight
items: CoreWeave (reported Tuesday night) beat on profit guidance and finished up 24%.
Fossil, Gevo and Azenta jumped more than 20% after upbeat results or outlooks.
Grocery Outlet, BrightView and Boyd Group fell after results and guidance disappointed.
After the close: Corteva, Franco-Nevada and Tetra Tech were scheduled to report.
Reports said Nvidia shares slipped more than 3% after hours.

sections.title: Business News
items: Marvell made an all-stock offer for Lumentum (4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share); Lumentum rallied.
Hims & Hers will sell Lilly GLP-1 drugs at $149 a month and stop compounded copies.
OpenAI reportedly acquired startup Odessia; Airbnb shares dipped on the report.
Nvidia's board opened an investigation into reports about CEO Jensen Huang.
Gulf damage estimates from the Iran conflict topped $200 billion, per Allianz Trade.

sections.title: On Deck
items: 7:30 AM CT: weekly jobless claims.
9:00 AM CT: October existing home sales.
Fed speakers: Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly and Schmid.
After the close: Cisco and Applied Materials report earnings.
Friday: producer price index (PPI).

Cowabunga! This is Surf Daddy, your local Kahuna, live from Surfside USA to all you Trade Wind surfers from the Gulf Coast to the North Shore. It's Wednesday, November eleventh, twenty twenty-six, and this is your Sunset Session, the full wrap of today's market. The sun is sliding down over the water, the last set is rolling in, and it was a good one.

My co-anchor has been guarding the cooler all afternoon. Gus the wonder dog, give the Trade Wind surfers a sunset hello! [BARK]

The Final Set. After Tuesday's wipeout, the swell came right back. The S and P five hundred closed up one point three percent at seven thousand six hundred nineteen. The Nasdaq hung ten, up one point six percent to twenty five thousand four hundred sixty six. The Dow added half a percent to fifty two thousand four hundred eighty six. The Russell two thousand rose about nine tenths of a percent. Tech led the paddle out, as A I stocks bounced back from a two day slide. Apple closed at a fresh record high.

Wind and Weather. It's Veterans Day, so the bond market was closed. The ten year yield sat near five percent from Tuesday, after a hot inflation report. Fed futures now price about a ninety percent chance of a rate hike in December. Oil rose to around eighty seven dollars on tension near the Strait of Hormuz. Gold slipped about one percent to just under four thousand dollars. Bitcoin edged up near seventy four thousand. No major U S data came out today.

The Lineup. CoreWeave was the big Kahuna, up about twenty four percent after strong results and a raised outlook. Now that's a wave worth riding. Gus, that one earns a biscuit! Here you go, buddy! [SNACK] SanDisk jumped thirteen percent. Micron and Dell gained about twelve percent each, and Arm climbed twelve percent too. Oracle added nearly nine percent. Nvidia bounced about three percent, but it's still been a gnarly ride there, with analyst downgrades and a board review of reports about its chief executive. On the down side, Microsoft fell about two percent, Meta dropped two percent, and Lululemon slid nearly four percent on slowing sales.

Tide Chart. CoreWeave reported Tuesday night and rode it all session. Fossil, Gevo and Azenta surged on upbeat results, while Grocery Outlet and BrightView wiped out. After the close, Corteva, Franco-Nevada and Tetra Tech are on the schedule. Reports say Nvidia slipped further after hours.

Beach Talk. Marvell has made an all stock offer for Lumentum, and Lumentum shares rallied. Hims and Hers will offer Lilly weight loss drugs at one hundred forty nine dollars a month and stop selling compounded copies. Reports say OpenAI bought a startup called Odessia, and Airbnb dipped on the news.

Tomorrow's Forecast. Weekly jobless claims land at seven thirty A M Central. Existing home sales follow at nine A M Central. A busy lineup of Fed speakers paddles out, including Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly and Schmid. After the close, Cisco and Applied Materials report. And producer prices arrive Friday.

So wax your board and catch the Dawn Patrol tomorrow morning. Want a read on any stock, E T F or futures contract? Type it in the Check a Wave box on the page, and Surf Daddy will call it for you.

This is information, not advice. This is Surf Daddy and Gus the wonder dog saying, if in doubt, paddle out!
